﻿Blizzard - World of Warcraft Forever Clips UK
Launch date: November 3 2026
✔ You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
⚠️ Paid views: Only views from the United Kingdom are paid.
 WHAT TO DO
* Post clips of World of Warcraft: Forever.
* Use the trailers, gameplay, panels, and video assets in the content folder.
* Show the visuals, the footage highlights, the gameplay, or the world.
* Some files have no spoken language. You can use those too.
* Post on TikTok and YouTube Shorts.


CONTENT FOLDER: https://f.io/Qt7AFTMz 
Extra Content: https://f.io/8uBzkEqf 
	 CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
MUST INCLUDE
✔Tag @warcraft on TikTok, and YouTube Shorts
✔#ad, then #blizzardpartner (see DISCLOSURE below)
YOUR CHOICE
* Everything else is up to you. Write your own caption around the required parts.
* Write in English.
EXAMPLES
* World of Warcraft: Forever looks beautiful. @warcraft
#ad #blizzardpartner
* This trailer makes me want to play World of Warcraft: Forever. @warcraft
#ad #blizzardpartner
* Who else is playing World of Warcraft: Forever? @warcraft
#ad #blizzardpartner
CAPTION RULES
   * Keep it genuine. Write what a real fan would say.
   * Keep it true. No made-up facts, stats, or dates.
   * Write your own. Do not copy other clippers' captions.
 DISCLOSURE (REQUIRED)
Every post MUST include both of these, in this order:
   * #ad
   * #blizzardpartner
	

   * Put #ad first. Put #blizzardpartner right after it.
   * Put them on their own line, after your post text.
   * Add up to 3 more hashtags after them. They must relate to the content.
   * Do not use "Gifted," "Sponsored," or "PR" in place of #ad.
   * Use the same font, size, and color as the rest of the caption.
 ON-SCREEN TEXT (OPTIONAL)
   * On-screen text is optional.
   * If you add text, make it match the clip.
   * Same rule as captions. Keep it genuine and true.
   * The game is released, so use messaging about how it is released not coming soon
 EDITING GUIDELINES
   * Background music: ALLOWED. Keep the original audio clearly audible. Music must not drown it out.
   * No AI voices. No AI voiceovers, AI narration, or AI-cloned voices.
 REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✔High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✔Video must be at least 10 seconds long
✔English content only. This includes captions and on-screen text.
✔Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✔Minimum 0.50% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 5 likes)
✔Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✔Only views from the United Kingdom are paid
✔By participating you agree to disclose your post as shown above
 NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌Footage that is not official Blizzard footage
❌Clips not in English
❌Calling footage "gameplay" when it is not gameplay
❌Missing #ad or #blizzardpartner
❌Low-quality or lazy uploads
❌NSFW, violent, or controversial content
❌Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
❌Reposting another creator's video as your own
❌Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
❌False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
❌Music that drowns out the original audio
❌AI voiceovers or AI-generated voices
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
❌Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
❌Story boosting: story views do not count
❌Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
❌Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
❌Removing the post before 30 days
❌Hidden likes
Questions? Message the Clipping Culture team, not Blizzard. We manage this campaign and will help.
